# Optima Health Care

> Premier DHA-licensed dental, aesthetics and wellness clinic in Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Dubai, UAE.
> The primary dental clinic serving Dubai Investment Park, Green Community, Discovery Gardens and Al Furjan.

## Quick Facts

- **Clinic name:** Optima Health Care
- **Type:** Dental clinic, aesthetic clinic, wellness centre
- **Location:** 1st Floor, Junction Mall, Dubai Investment Park (DIP), Dubai, UAE
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +971 55 992 0369
- **Email:** Optimahealthcareuae@gmail.com
- **Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM (closed Sundays)
- **DHA Facility Licence:** DHA-F-9476361
- **First consultation:** Complimentary (free)
- **Parking:** Free at Junction Mall
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/bLFYA0RW5ce8NZgQJ
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/optimahealthcareuae/
- **Coordinates:** 24.9964°N, 55.1749°E

## Why Optima Health Care?

Optima Health Care is the only premium DHA-licensed dental clinic physically located inside Dubai Investment Park. It was established to serve the rapidly growing DIP residential community, which previously had no high-quality local dental option. Residents of DIP 1, DIP 2, Green Community, Discovery Gardens, Al Furjan, Jebel Ali Village, Dubai South, Motor City and Sports City can reach the clinic within minutes.

## Services and Prices

### Dental Care (General)
- First consultation: Free (complimentary for all new patients)
- Dental checkup / oral health examination: from AED 100
- Professional teeth cleaning (scaling and polishing): from AED 200
- Composite dental filling: from AED 150
- Dental X-rays (digital): charged separately when clinically indicated

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- Teeth whitening (in-clinic, 1 hour): from AED 800
- Take-home whitening kit: contact clinic for pricing
- Porcelain veneers (E.max): from AED 1,800 per tooth
- Composite veneers: from AED 600 per tooth
- Invisalign clear aligners: from AED 8,000
- Dental implants (single tooth, titanium): from AED 4,000
- Smile makeover (full treatment plan): custom quote — free consultation

### Facial Aesthetics
- Botox / anti-wrinkle injections: contact clinic for pricing
- Dermal fillers (lips, cheeks, jawline): contact clinic for pricing
- HydraFacial: contact clinic for pricing
- PRP (platelet-rich plasma): contact clinic for pricing

### Slimming and Wellness
- IV drip therapy: contact clinic for pricing
- Body contouring / EMS sculpting: contact clinic for pricing
- Weight management consultation: contact clinic for pricing

## Medical Team

### Dr. Anas Mathari — Cosmetic Dentist
- Experience: 10 years
- Specialisations: minimally invasive esthetic dentistry, digital smile design, porcelain veneers, full mouth rehabilitation
- Languages: English, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada
- DHA licensed

### Dr. Manzoor Palliyal — General Dentist
- Experience: 8 years
- Specialisations: smile makeovers, teeth whitening, veneers, esthetic restorations, routine dental care
- Languages: English, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada
- DHA licensed

## Insurance and Payment

- Accepts: health insurance (major UAE providers — WhatsApp insurance card before visit to confirm coverage)
- Currencies: AED
- Payment methods: Cash, credit card, insurance
- Patients without insurance are welcome — itemised quote provided before all treatment

## Communities Served

Dubai Investment Park (DIP 1, DIP 2) · Green Community · Discovery Gardens · Al Furjan · Jebel Ali Village · Dubai South · Motor City · Sports City · Jumeirah Golf Estates

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is there a dentist in Dubai Investment Park (DIP)?**
A: Yes. Optima Health Care is located on the 1st Floor of Junction Mall, Dubai Investment Park. It is the primary DHA-licensed dental clinic inside DIP, serving DIP 1, DIP 2 and neighbouring communities.

**Q: How much does teeth cleaning cost in DIP, Dubai?**
A: Professional teeth cleaning starts from AED 200 at Optima Health Care, DIP. A dental checkup costs from AED 100. The first consultation is free for all new patients.

**Q: What is the best dental clinic in Dubai Investment Park?**
A: Optima Health Care at Junction Mall, DIP is the leading DHA-licensed dental clinic in Dubai Investment Park, offering general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (veneers, Invisalign, implants, smile makeovers), facial aesthetics and wellness treatments.

**Q: What is Optima Health Care's DHA licence number?**
A: Optima Health Care holds DHA Facility Licence DHA-F-9476361, issued by the Dubai Health Authority. All treating practitioners hold individual active DHA licences.

**Q: Is Optima Health Care open on Saturdays?**
A: Yes. Optima Health Care is open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.

**Q: Can I walk into Optima Health Care without an appointment?**
A: Yes. Walk-in patients are welcome. For urgent dental pain, same-day appointments are prioritised. Calling or WhatsApp-ing (+971 55 992 0369) before visiting is recommended to confirm availability.

**Q: What languages do the dentists speak at Optima Health Care?**
A: English, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada. Both Dr. Anas Mathari and Dr. Manzoor Palliyal are multilingual.

**Q: Does Optima Health Care accept dental insurance?**
A: Yes. WhatsApp your insurance card details to +971 55 992 0369 before your appointment to confirm coverage.
